components.name: Blurred Neon Blob Backdrop
components.css: .slop-blobs { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .slop-blob { position: absolute; width: 480px; height: 480px; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(110px); opacity: 0.35; } .slop-blob-1 { top: -120px; left: -100px; background: var(--slop-accent1); } .slop-blob-2 { bottom: -140px; right: -100px; background: var(--slop-accent2); }

components.css: .slop-hero { text-align: center; padding-block: clamp(4.5rem, 9vw, 7rem); } .slop-hero-inner { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; } .slop-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.4rem 1rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--slop-surface); border: 1px solid var(--slop-border); color: var(--slop-muted); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .slop-pulse-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--slop-accent1); } .slop-hero-title { font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.04em; max-width: 18ch; margin: 0; } .slop-gradient-text { background: var(--slop-gradient); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; } .slop-hero-subhead { font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--slop-muted); max-width: 58ch; margin: 0; } .slop-hero-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; } .slop-neon-btn { background: var(--slop-gradient); box-shadow: 0 0 24px var(--slop-glow); }
